# Premium

Interest is $$\int Yf(Y\mid d)dY-\int Yf(Y\mid D,X)f(D\mid X)f(X\mid d)dYdDdX$$

# Level

Interest is $$\int Yf(Y\mid D,X)f(D\mid X)f(X\mid d)dYdDdX$$

$$=\int Yf(Y\mid X)f(X\mid d)dYdX$$

Efficient influence function is

$$f(D=d)\phi=I(D=d)E[Y\mid X]$$

$$+(Y-E[Y\mid X])\times f(d\mid X)$$

# R

## Differnce

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

arrow::open_dataset(
  "Data/Tokyo_20053_20241.parquet"
)

data <- nanoparquet::read_parquet("Data/Tokyo_20053_20241.parquet") |> 
  mutate(
    Year = 取引時期 |> 
      str_sub(1,4) |> 
      as.numeric(),
    Price = (取引価格/1000000),
    Size = 面積,
    Tenure = 2023 - as.numeric(str_sub(建築年,1,4)),
    Distance = 最寄駅_距離,
    Distict = 市区町村名,
    SRC = if_else(
      建物の構造 == "ＳＲＣ",
      1,
      0
    ),
    Zone = 都市計画
  ) |> 
  filter(
    Year %in% c(2021,2023),
    種類 == "中古マンション等",
    str_detect(市区町村名,"区")
  ) |> 
  na.omit()

table(data$Distict[data$Size == 70],data$Year[data$Size == 70])

data$Size |> table()

data |> 
  filter(Size >= 70 & Size <= 75) |> 
  mutate(
    N = n(),
    P = mean(Price),
    .by = c(Year,Distict)
  ) |> 
  distinct(
    N,
    P,
    Year,
    Distict
  ) |> 
  arrange(
    Distict,
    Year
  ) |> 
  mutate(
    C_N = (N/lag(N)) |> log(),
    C_P = (P/lag(P)) |> log(),
    .by = Distict
  ) |> 
  na.omit() |> 
  ggplot(
    aes(
      x = C_N,
      y = C_P,
      label = Distict
    )
  ) +
  geom_point() +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel() +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = 0
  ) +
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = 0
  )
  
```
